title: CWP/7236/2025 of MOHIT Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHERS
judge: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VINOD S. BHARDWAJ
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB & HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 108 Date of decision: 18.03.2025 Mohit ...Petitioner VERSUS State of Haryana and others ...Respondents CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VINOD S. BHARDWAJ Present :- Mr. V.S. Rathee, Advocate for the petitioner(s). VINOD S. BHARDWAJ, J. (Oral)

1. Challenge in the present petition is to the notice/announcement dated 17.10.2024 qua ESP (Gen.) issued by the Haryana Staff Selection Commission wherein the candidates having less marks than the petitioner have been declared selected, ignoring his claim.

2. After arguing at some length, learned counsel for the petitioner(s) submits that as regards his grievances mentioned in the petition, the petitioner(s) has already sent a representation dated 13.12.2024 (Annexure P-13) to respondent No.2-the Secretary, Haryana Staff Selection Commission and he would be satisfied in case the said respondent is directed to consider and decide the said representation by passing a well reasoned and speaking order in a time bound manner.

3. Notice of motion. 2 108 CWP-7236-2025 (O&M)

4. Ms. Tanisha Peshawaria, DAG Haryana, accepts notice on behalf of respondent(s)-State and submits that she has no objection to the aforesaid prayer being granted.

5. With the consent of the parties, the present petition is accordingly disposed of without commenting on the merits of the present case and with a direction to respondent No.2-the Secretary, Haryana Staff Selection Commission to take note of the representation dated 13.12.2024 (Annexure P-13) sent by the petitioner and to pass a well reasoned and speaking order thereupon after granting an opportunity of hearing to the respective parties in accordance with law and preferably within a period of 02 months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order. (VINOD S. BHARDWAJ) 18.03.2025 JUDGE Mangal Singh
